tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Period - FY 2015-16,FY 2016-17 and Apr 2017-Jun 2017 Issue - Non-Inclusion of Freight charged to customers in the assessable value for determination of Excise Duty liability in respect of Ex-Works Sales. The Company has filed an Appeal with CESTAT in respect of the same and awaits the hearing. Quantum of Claims - Rs. 172 Mn
tax_litigation.status: The matter is still pending and there is no change.
